nginx: configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf test is successful
# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
events { }
http {
    include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/museum.org:
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name museum.org;
    root /home/museum.org/httpdocs;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/museum-old.org:
server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name museum.org;
    root /var/www/old;
    if ($scheme = http) {
        return 301 https://museum.org$request_uri;
    }
}
